pcs.pc_description: Review the job instructions and design specifications received from responsible personnel, ensuring clarity on design, color palette, and areas to be painted.
Confirm that the instructions and design details are complete and accurate.
Clarify any uncertainties or missing information with the supervisor or manager before proceeding.

modules.module_title: Gather Tools, Materials, and Raw Materials

pcs.pc_description: Collect all required tools and equipment, ensuring they align with the job requirements and approved procedures.
Ensure all raw materials, including glass articles and paints, are available and in suitable condition for the task.
Check that all tools and materials are clean, undamaged, and fit for use in the design process.

modules.module_title: Inspect Materials and Plan the Work Sequence

pcs.pc_description: Visually inspect the glass articles for defects such as chips, cracks, or rough edges and ensure they meet the design requirements.
Plan the sequence of tasks for efficient execution, ensuring that drying times, material curing, and other requirements are factored in.
Ensure that the work plan aligns with safety protocols and follows the design specifications.

modules.module_title: Prepare the Work Area and Ensure Safety

pcs.pc_description: Organize the work area to ensure it is clean, spacious, and well-ventilated for safe work conditions.
Set up appropriate lighting for detailed design work and ensure all tools and materials are within easy reach.
Verify that necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) is available, such as gloves, aprons, goggles, or masks, and ensure they are in good condition.
Inspect all equipment, including glass- cutting tools and ovens, to ensure they are safe and functional for use.
